children: At first glance, R2-D2 seems an unassuming Astromech Droid, typical of his series. But Artoo is unusual in that he has an unique personality quirk: courage. Artoo demonstrates his bravery again and again, taking the typical

unit's helpfulness to an unheard-of extreme. Although he serves faithfully, Artoo does so in the manner he feels is best- which doesn't always coincide with the instructions given to him. In addition to being innovative and resourceful, he is often absolutely right about the best course of action.
